correctness.rationale: At angle theta disk hitting is exactly t in interval [p_i−r,p_i+r]; integrate 3 single, 3 pair and 1 triple overlap measures. Pair integral B(q)=2[q asin q+sqrt(1−q²)−1]; equilateral directional triangle width has 6 sectors cos(delta), min sqrt3/2, hence triple T(q)=6∫_{acos q}^{pi/6}(q−cos delta)d delta above threshold. Inclusion-exclusion and factorial moments invert to full P(K=j) and Z, with no independence assumption. The maximal adjacent projection gap is sqrt3 d/2, and connected interval union yields Z=3+pi q by Cauchy width. At 3 critical angles width cusp w/d=q0+|u|/2+O(u²), giving the 24epsilon² law and, after theta/offset scaling, 3 copies of uniform diamond of area 8. Derivative identity proves triple probability strictly increasing; q=1 is only an excluded limiting case.

originality.rationale: Standard Crofton line measures, pairwise projection overlaps and existence of common transversals are background, not new. Montejano–Karasev gives topological/Helly consequences of transversals of convex families, and Bracho–Montejano–Oliveros studies topology of transversal spaces. Their theorems do not provide the exact conditional invariant-measure three-hit distribution or blowup diamond law, which requires third factorial intersection and the triangle-width cusp. Nearby Resultary third-order overlaps of spherical caps are a different sampling space.
